purpose: Implement an independently clocked, no-trade, no-wallet, read-only, locally persisted Base WETH/cbBTC four-hour observation collector with Docker Compose scaffold. Engineering work, not OOS strategy evidence or proof of scheduler uptime.
baseline: PR80 verified 9/18 GitHub schedule-run creations and 1/18 timely paired bars in Oct28–30. Same-GitHub 23m/47m crons cannot ensure six daily closes.

architecture.runner: Container continuously awakened by its own UTC wall-clock, single candidate at 12 minutes after 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC close, no guessed prior timestamps.
architecture.source_integrity: Reuse existing PR76 slot guard, original read-only Base provider collector and strict snapshot_summary; store original collected_utc and raw response hashes without alteration.
architecture.persistent_artifacts: Local bind-mounted forward/*.json plus operational events and heartbeat; not automatically uploaded to GitHub or counted as 194-bar qualification.
architecture.safe_defaults: NETWORK DISABLED unless explicit ARZ_COLLECTOR_NETWORK=explicit-readonly; no keys, signing, swapping, allowance or order broadcast; Docker container non-root and read-only.
architecture.race_recovery: Atomic O_EXCL file writes and PID lock; stale lock requires manual review; fail closed on invalid source; exceptions recorded without revealing provider payload.

tests: Valid runtime snapshot accepted with source timestamp unchanged
Wrong bar or future timestamp rejected
UTC next-slot computation handles exact boundaries
acceptance: PR CI runs targeted synthetic tests and whole suite, no real market API or RPC calls in CI; source snapshots never promoted to executable prices or qualified investment paper.
limitations: No independently authorized deployment host, no third party cost API authorization, no validated future uninterrupted 194-bar run, no +60s real follower fill, no 90-day prospective paper, no financial approval.
